title: Institutional Avalanche! $1B Treasury Funds & Bitwise ETP Fuel Massive AVAX Pump | BOTR | 3.0 TV
description:
Avalanche Staking ETP (AVNB), which is physically backed, has been introduced by Bitwise Europe on Deutsche Börse Xetra. 

With built-in staking rewards, the ETP exposes institutions to Avalanche's (AVAX) native token. Institutional investment in Avalanche is rising.

AgriFORCE Growing Systems, a bitcoin mining company, revealed plans to launch an Avalanche treasury. After the announcement, the company's stock price surged, at one time climbing more than 200% for the day. 

Anthony Scarmucci has joined AgriFORCE's advisory board, and the organization is funding $300M through a PIPE headed by HiveMind Capital. $1B treasury funds into AVAX. How a $1B treasury bet affects AVAX

Through LayerZero and its Stargate Hydra bridge, PayPal is expanding support for a permissionless version of its PYUSD stablecoin on Tron, Avalanche, and multiple other blockchains.

PYUSD0 will be interoperable between blockchains and ""fully fungible"" with the PYUSD. LayerZero will make it possible to mint, burn, and deploy PYUSD0, while Stargate Hydra will act as the interface for PYUSD0 transactions. 

KRW1, a digital currency based on the value of the won, has been formally introduced by South Korea's BDACS. The stablecoin is backed by money that is safely kept at Woori Bank and is issued on Avalanche. Why is AVAX pumping?

asr.full_text: Avalanche TVN has doubled in just one month Avalanche treasury company made a big announcement Avax is set to hold $1 billion long-term goal Will Avax reach $50 by the end of 2025? In today's B Block on the rocks and his Avax. Right now there is a $32.5 worth of price. and it is 23% up in a month. Right now, there is a $12.80 billion market cap on this chain. On top of that, If we talk about the TVL, its TVL is $2.28 billion and and above is on the top of TBL. And if we talk about the transaction speed of Avalanche, then in one second, it can process 4,500 transactions. Now let's talk about recent developments of Avalanche. BitWise Europe has launched the physically backed, Avalanche Staking ETP on Deutsche Börs Extra and along with this, this ETP will provide institutional exposure to AVAX along with integrated staking rewards. Avalanche treasury company has been announced to be merging with Mountain Lake Acquisition Corporation with value of $675 million as per the deal. All these companies will debut in the combined with each other's company in Q1 of 2026 under the ticker AVAT. At this time, its Regulatory and Shareholder approval is pending. However, Avalanche treasury is expecting at first $465 million and its long term goalx holding of $1M. Let me tell you about the recent Avalanche Surges that is happening in Avalanche, Transaction Volume has jumped 226% in September, Active addresses have increased 20% as well and fees has been increased to 86%, So the average price of the product was only 19 to 26 million, and the price growth period was 25 percent. Apart from that, there is also a market increase because of the sale of EV, which is about 80 to 70 percent in the last week. So there is a lowest price in 2025, it is 135% up which is $36. So Avalanche and AVAX is performing really amazing from the last few months. And, like we said, Avalanche's DeFi TVL has reached $2 billion which is doubled in a month. And this is Avalanche's TVL's highest in two years. So we can still hear all very good news regarding A right now. And that is why all these highlights tell us that renewed confidence has emerged. About people in Avalanche ecosystem and let's move to next. The Bitcoin mining firm Agri Force has announced that it wants to start Avalanche treasury and the stock price of the firm increased by 200 % last day. which is amazing. An Agri-Force is raising $300 million via pipe, led by Hivemind Capital. Also, they are going to add Anthony Scaramucci to their advisory board. Moving ahead, let's talk about PayPal. So PayPal is adding its permissionless version of PYUSD stable coin on Tron, Avalanche and several Blockchains via Layer 0 and its Stargate Hydra bridge. Coming to South Korea, KW8, KW1, which is an one-backed stable coin, is not officially launched by BDACS and is issued on Avalanche and it is supported by funds secured held at Woorie bank. We have already discussed DFY TVL on Avalanche and there are top 3 protocols on it are Aave, Benkey or Centrifuge. So, Aave is a decentralized lending protocol. Avalanche has a TVL is 1.06 Billion Dollars in Avalanche Banky is the leading decentralized finance protocol with TVL of $710 million If we talk about Centrifuge, that is a decentralized protocol bridging traditional finance and DeFi by tokenizing real world assets Its TVL is $251 Million Talking about the price prediction The Coinpedia report has stated that the price of the Avax by the end ofVAX will reach $50 by 2025 once it is ETO approved . So keep an eye on AVAX. Before investing, do your own research and dont forget to consult your financial advisor. Like share and subscribe to our channel. Keep watching 3dollro tb.
